newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan cable makers to enjoy strong demand - Moody's.
newsitem.headline: Japan cable makers to enjoy strong demand - Moody's.

text.p: Japan's electric wire and cable manufacturers will likely continue to enjoy robust demand for optical fibre cables, Moody's Investors Service said on Monday.

The U.S.-based credit rating firm predicted that the optical fibre market's volume will continue to grow more than 20 percent annually as current copper telephone lines are rapidly replaced with optical fiber lines.
Moody's said growth in the cable market will be boosted by a government plan to connect each home with optical fibre cables by 2010.

But Moody's added that uncertainties surrounding Nippon Telegraph & Telephone Corp (NTT), whose reorganisation is currently being discussed between the government and the firm, clouded the cable market's growth prospects.
Only NTT has the technological and financial resources to conduct the government's project to build a nationwide optical fibre cable network, Moody's said.
